heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 105–277, div. G, subdiv. A, title XIII, § 1336(1), Oct. 21, 1998, 112 Stat. 2681–790

notes.text: Section 1475b, act Jan. 27, 1948, ch. 36, title VIII, § 807, as added Pub. L. 95–426, title II, § 204(c), Oct. 7, 1978, 92 Stat. 974; amended Pub. L. 97–241, title III, § 303(b), Aug. 24, 1982, 96 Stat. 291, related to seal of the United States Information Agency.

Section 1475c, act Jan. 27, 1948, ch. 36, title VIII, § 808, as added Pub. L. 97–241, title III, § 304(e), Aug. 24, 1982, 96 Stat. 293, provided for Acting Associate Director in the event of death, resignation, illness, or absence of Associate Director.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Oct. 1, 1999, see section 1301 of Pub. L. 105–277, set out as an Effective Date note under section 6531 of this title.
